name: Akane no Chiisana Hanabira
source:
Akane was sexually harassed by her sister's fiance Takeru, but Akane, who likes Takeru, couldn't turn him down. His harassment escalates and Akane eventually ends up losing her virginity.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.usamimi.info/~wakabakaoru/wp201403/?page_id=936]official website[/url]]
translation:
茜遭到姐姐的未婚夫武的性骚扰，但喜欢武的茜却无法拒绝他。他的骚扰不断升级，茜最终失去了童贞。

[翻译自[url=http://www.usamimi.info/~wakabakaoru/wp201403/?page_id=936]官网[/url]]
